options.name: Amulet
options.benefit: Choose a masterwork amulet worn in the neck slot as the bonded object.

options.name: Ring
options.benefit: Choose a masterwork ring worn in a ring slot as the bonded object.

options.name: Staff
options.benefit: Choose a masterwork staff held in one hand as the bonded object.

options.name: Wand
options.benefit: Choose a masterwork wand held in one hand as the bonded object. It remains a bonded object after its final wand charge is expended.

options.name: Weapon
options.benefit: Choose a masterwork weapon held in one hand as the bonded object. A 1st-level bonded weapon is not made from a special material.
